primary_architecture: Frozen v2 TRIBE-only EEG temporal ensemble plus strongly regularized, bounded multimodal residual readout

preprocessing.fit_scope: Unique training content bins/windows only; quantiles, feature masks, moments, PCA and score scales fitted inside every fold

temporal_controls: Same v2 temporal architecture, AdamW defaults, 100 epochs, seeds and budget; new bounded preprocessing and auxiliary gain

residual.design: Per-block sequence mean, standard deviation and second-half minus first-half mean; window-level auxiliary descriptors
residual.bound: Every target changes by at most 0.1 training-fold target SD relative to its frozen anchor; not a guarantee of lower error
residual.variance: Positive softplus shift around the anchor; no post-hoc output clipping
residual.negative_control: Within-viewing cyclic EEG reassignment for correction training only; anchor remains fixed

evaluation: Identical 1020 rows, eight crossed topic-family/participant-group folds and eight v2 targets/scales
deployment_choice: Always export prespecified bounded residual fusion; do not choose an arm or seed using outer scores
quality_audit: Integrity, receiver-clock limitations, same-content agreement, participant offsets; no fabricated sample clock, new filtering or outcome-driven exclusions
